methods.label: Evaluate the inner powers first
methods.explanation:
At \(x=2\), each occurrence of \(x^x\) becomes \(2^2=4\). Therefore the base and exponent of the outer power are both four:
\[(x^x)^{(x^x)}=4^4=4\cdot4\cdot4\cdot4=256.\]
The answer is choice C.
